question: Which three distinct third-page visits are most frequently observed immediately after two consecutive visits to the '/detail' page, and how many times does each third-page visit occur?
sql:
-- Top 3 distinct third-page visits after two consecutive /detail visits (normalized paths)
WITH normalized AS (
  SELECT 
    stamp, 
    session, 
    option, 
    CASE 
      WHEN path IN ('/detail', '/detail/') THEN '/detail'
      WHEN path LIKE '%/' AND path != '/' THEN TRIM(TRAILING '/' FROM path)
      ELSE TRIM(path)
    END as path,
    TRIM(search_type) as search_type
  FROM activity_log
),
with_rn AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, path) as rn
  FROM normalized
),
consecutive_detail AS (
  SELECT 
    w1.session,
    w1.rn as rn1,
    w1.path as path1,
    w2.path as path2,
    w3.path as path3
  FROM with_rn w1
  JOIN with_rn w2 ON w1.session = w2.session AND w2.rn = w1.rn + 1
  JOIN with_rn w3 ON w1.session = w3.session AND w3.rn = w1.rn + 2
  WHERE w1.path = '/detail' AND w2.path = '/detail'
)
SELECT path3 as third_page_visit, COUNT(*) as occurrence_count
FROM consecutive_detail
GROUP BY path3
ORDER BY occurrence_count DESC
LIMIT 3
